$comment: ADR-2122 (custody X-1 step 1, W1): the single source for per-role service accounts. flake.nix bakes /etc/passwd and /etc/group from it, and `agentbox-manifest role-accounts isolate` derives /etc/supervisord.roles.conf and the /run/secrets delivery plan from today's rendered supervisord.conf with it. Inert unless [security].role_isolation = true. A secret is EITHER `source` (a file path; the program's own environment= value for `env` wins over it, unless that value is the secret's `legacy` path, which the custody migrate step copies from once and never deletes) OR `from_env` (a PID-1 environment variable, written to the file and unset before supervisord). `env` names the variable the program reads the path from; the isolated config points it at /run/secrets/<role>/<file>. Never put a secret VALUE here.

reserved_ids.965: host docker group: docker-compose.override.yml group_add. A role whose gid is 965 would sit in the Docker socket's group, and the Docker daemon is root on the host.

roles.name: ab-identity
roles.purpose: identity signer: the nostr-pod-bridge daemon (relay slot, NIP-59 unwrap). Sole holder of the sovereign/operator, JunkieJarvis and concierge keys; it runs the identity port (serve-identity, W3), which signs for every other caller through /run/secrets/ab-identity-port/identity.sock.

at_rest.purpose: The sovereign identity file nostr-pod-bridge bootstrap writes (root reads it at boot). Flag off: devuser 0600 (management-api's pods signer). Flag on: ab-identity 0400; the pods signer goes through the identity port.
JunkieJarvis zone keys. Copied once from the workspace bind; the workspace copy stays (Q5) and is what flag-off readers use until W3b moves the zone gate.

roles.name: ab-gateway
roles.purpose: nostr-gateway: operator DMs and relay AUTH. Holds no key; signs through the identity port (W3a), reads the AoE bearer through the aoe-share copy (design 2.6, W2).

roles.name: ab-ingress
roles.purpose: nip98-proxy: the LAN door. Break-glass bearer and session secret.

roles.name: ab-spend
roles.purpose: hitch host and pay402 spend keys. Account only in step 1: owner disposition Q6 defers the spend port (W5), so pay402 and Hitch stay devuser-class.

roles.name: ab-sidestr-dreamlab
roles.purpose: sidestr:dreamlab producer: block-signing key and parent RPC credential.

roles.name: ab-faucet-dreamlab
roles.purpose: sidestr:dreamlab faucet: treasury key. 965 is skipped (reserved_ids).

groups.name: ab-identity-port
groups.purpose: The identity port's socket group (ADR-2122, W3). /run/secrets/ab-identity-port/ is ab-identity:ab-identity-port 0750 inside the root-owned secrets mount, so devuser (owner of /run) cannot rename it; the socket is 0660 in this group. The group only narrows who can connect: authorisation is SO_PEERCRED against config/custody/identity-port-acl.json, whose callers are devuser (1000) and ab-gateway (961). ab-identity is a member because chgrp needs membership. 969 is the next free id (965 reserved).

at_rest_dirs.purpose: The agentbox-secrets volume. Flag on: root:root 0700, so devuser cannot list or open any at-rest copy; root copies each role's files into /run/secrets/<role>/ at boot.

The sovereign-identities volume. Flag on: root:root 0711, not 0700, because the pay402/Hitch spend keys (management-api/lib/sidestr-spend-key.js) stay devuser-class until the spend port (owner decision Q6) and are opened by known name. devuser cannot list it, and agentbox-core.json inside it is ab-identity 0400.

dirs.purpose: Identity-port sign receipts: written by ab-identity, read by devuser (the rehearsal, operators). The parent is devuser-owned, so the port cannot create it itself.
Custody W4: sidechain state on the agentbox-events volume. Under the flag a role program's HOME is on the /run/secrets tmpfs, so the workspace defaults would lose the chain on every boot.

sidestr:dreamlab block files (run-producer.sh SIDESTR_STATE under the flag). The producer writes (umask 027); the devuser mirror reads through the group. Seeded once from the workspace state, which stays.
sidestr:dreamlab-txbt4 block files, as for dreamlab.

sidestr:dreamlab faucet grant ledger (run-faucet.sh SIDESTR_FAUCET_STATE under the flag). Losing it would re-grant every claimant. Seeded once from the workspace ledger, which stays. Group devuser reads it (grant records, no key) so a flag-off run-faucet.sh can refuse a stale workspace ledger.
sidestr:dreamlab-txbt4 faucet grant ledger, as for dreamlab.
